## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- **Web-friendly comics: advice only.** The heavy files are the print set (13–30 MB per giant
  board, 30 MB cover). Proposed: render each page from the live comic (not the 4K print redraws),
  as WebP at ~1600 px, with a ~2400 px zoom size and a 400 px thumbnail, and a reader on
  riverbanks.lol. That depends on finishing the server renderer in
  `2026-10-01_page-export` (still a draft). Waiting on Yan: where it is hosted, and whether a PDF
  is wanted.
- **Comic archive** ([plan](../plans/2026-10-10_comic-archive.plan.md)). New column
  `archived_at`. The trigger lets only the owner archive or restore, and archiving does not bump
  `rev` or `updated_at`. The delete policy now requires an archived comic, so a live comic cannot
  be deleted in one step, from the web or over MCP. New MCP tools `archive_comic` and
  `restore_comic`; `list_comics { archived: true }`. On My comics, Archive replaces Delete, with
  Undo and an Archived (n) section that has Restore and Delete forever. Unit, integration (36) and
  a keyboard e2e all pass locally. The migration is **local only**: Yan to run `supabase db push`,
  then deploy.
- Local stack trouble: Docker stopped mid-session, and after it restarted `supabase start` kept
  rolling back because Realtime takes ~40 s to become healthy. Fix that worked:
  `supabase start --ignore-health-check -x studio,postgres-meta,imgproxy,logflare,vector,mailpit`,
  then wait for Realtime. Also removed a stale, empty `.git/index.lock` from 7 Oct.

### Two e2e tests still expect the 12-panel page

<details>

`e2e/auth.e2e.ts:6` and `e2e/share.e2e.ts:13` expect 12 panels on a new comic (and 11 after one
merge). Since `2482b25` (2 Oct), new comics default to the A1 board, a 4×4 grid of 16 panels, so
both fail at the count. This predates the archive work. Fix: update the counts and the panel
indexes the share test clicks, or create those comics in the `comic` format.

</details>
